metadata.name: Politeness and request framing
metadata.description: Candidate-only request framing terms informed by politeness theory and request-act studies; these affect tone, not task constraints, so users can disable the extension if tone must be preserved.

sources.name: Brown & Levinson (1987), Politeness: Some Universals in Language Usage
Blum-Kulka, House & Kasper (1989), Cross-Cultural Pragmatics: Requests and Apologies
